title: AC1018 TABLE rectangular plain-text grid codec

authority.source: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.relevantRule: The body stores bounded column and row counts, repeats column widths and row heights, then repeats cell data for all cells in the n by m table.

implementation.summary: The private AC1018 direct TABLE codec now emits rectangular one-or-more-row and one-or-more-column grids within existing row, column, cell and text bounds. Preflight requires count fields to match the model, each row to have exactly the declared number of cells, supported row/column defaults, and every cell to pass the existing plain-text/override loss guards. Encoding emits dimensions, widths, heights and cells in row-major order. Each cell contributes its value-handle slot and any selected text-style override handle. Public dwgRW::writeTable remains refused.

coverage: Fresh typed readback of row/column counts, column widths, row heights, all four row-major text values, and the second-row/second-column hard-pointer text-style override
Exact body boundary and following-body sentinel alignment
Destination-preserving refusal for uncounted rows and rows with incomplete cell grids
Existing single-cell parser/writer override, malformed-span, handle-role and retry controls

limitations: Generated encoder/parser self-consistency only; no physical AC1018 producer witness or independent-reader result is established.
Only plain-text cells with already admitted override families are supported by this private codec; block, FIELD, attribute, merge, linked-data and unsupported override profiles remain refused.
The codec remains private experimental coverage and is not connected to public dwgRW::writeTable.
The anonymous *T block graph, compound transaction, physical source-to-output proof, native rendering and broad support claims remain open.
nextAction: Find an eligible physical AC1018 TABLE whose complete cell body can be bounded and matched. Keep the public compound writer disabled until physical body agreement, the *T graph transaction and independent readback are established.
